paragraphs.text: 1. FILLING our hearts with health and joy, may Vata breathe his balm on us
paragraphs.original: वात आ वातु भेषजं शम्भु मयोभु नो हृदे ।
paragraphs.translit: vāta ā vātu bheṣajaṃ śambhu mayobhu no hṛde |

paragraphs.text: May he prolong our days of life.
2. Thou art our Father, Vata, yea, thou art a Brother and a friend,
paragraphs.original: उत वात पितासि न उत भ्रातोत नः सखा ।
paragraphs.translit: uta vāta pitāsi na uta bhrātota naḥ sakhā |

paragraphs.text: So give us strength that we may live.
3. The store of Amrta laid away yonder, O Vata, in thine home,-
Give us thereof that we may live.
